title: AS2 compiler: labeled break/continue and with-statement
description: Implement two missing AS2 language features in packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts: (1) Labeled break/continue: 'outer: for(...) { inner: for(...) { break outer; } }' — emit ActionJump with correct backpatch to the label's exit point. The parser may already produce LabeledStatement and BreakStatement(label)/ContinueStatement(label) nodes; check parser.ts. (2) with-statement: 'with(obj) { x = 1; }' — emit ActionWith (0x94) with block length. Both are uncommon but appear in Flash 8 component code. Add 6 tests each in __tests__/labeled.test.ts.
